title: Dr Frost Arctic Strawberry Coconut Ice Cream 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Nic Salt Strawberry Coconut Ice Cream combines the sweet, ripe flavour of fresh Strawberries with the smooth, creamy taste of Coconut Ice Cream, finished with a refreshing menthol exhale. This indulgent yet refreshing blend offers a unique balance of dessert and cool fruit flavours, making it a perfect choice for vapers who enjoy sweet and frosty e-liquids. As part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid features a double-concentrated Bar Salts flavour, designed to replicate the bold and intense taste of disposable vapes. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, Strawberry Coconut Ice Cream Nic Salt is ideal for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits and low-powered devices, providing smooth throat hits and quick nicotine relief. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Strawberry Coconut Ice Cream is a versatile and flavourful option for adult smokers and vapers.
